scope: All process.json receipts inside selfhost/build/phase113 guard directories found at snapshot. Finalized successful and unsuccessful runs count; unfinished intervals do not. Inner job/stage durations are not added.

method.discovery: Scoped recursive process.json search, filtered to paths containing a guard directory.
method.finalized: Finite started, finished and wallSeconds; finished>=started and wallSeconds>=0. complete is an outcome flag, not the terminal-state test.
method.wall: Union of [started,finished] intervals. Also report monotonic wallSeconds sum; do not add nested job or emission/build stage durations.
method.resources: Maximum sampled process-tree RSS and minimum sampled host MemAvailable across finalized guards. Never sum memory peaks.
limitations: Guard coverage includes process startup, waits and I/O; it is not CPU execution time.
Gaps are unaccounted by these guards, not proof of inactivity or an estimate of model labor.
Host-side source work, user interruptions and work outside this guard scope are not measured.
No model token cost, engineer labor or CPU-seconds are available from these receipts.
An ongoing receipt can change after this snapshot; it is excluded from the totals.

native31FinalAttempt.status: Finalized unsuccessful: hosted full-compiler emission reached its 600-second job timeout. No completed native image or self-reproduction is inferred.

excludedReceipts.exclusion: No finalized started/finished/wallSeconds interval; ongoing or incomplete receipt.
